title: Team Leader – Quality Methods & Insights (QMI), Pune
description:
Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes - all while providing platinum customer support to our clients.

  
  
  
  

**The team:**

  

Data Management & Operations (DMO) serves as the Chief Operations Office for Bloomberg Data, with the Quality Methods & Insights (QMI) team acting as its strategic analytics and methodology partner. QMI drives data quality, timeliness, and operational efficiency across Bloomberg's data products by establishing quality governance standards, optimizing workflows, delivering common reporting and analytics, applying decision science to support investments and operational change, and developing workflow telemetry and productivity measurement capabilities. We partner closely with Data Operations, Vendor Management, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure global data processes scale efficiently, predictably, and with measurable quality outcomes.

  
  
  

**The role:**

  

In this role, you will lead a regional team of process engineers, data quality analysts, decision scientists, and analytics specialists who partner directly with APAC-based Data operations, Vendor Managers, and Product Engineering. You will act as the regional ambassador for QMI’s methodologies, driving high-impact initiatives that range from operational workflow measurement and vendor quality governance to process redesign. Success in this position requires a balance of inspirational people leadership, rigorous analytical craft, and executive stakeholder management. You will champion a culture of "context over control," empowering your team to solve complex problems independently while ensuring regional deliverables seamlessly align with QMI’s global strategic objectives across London, Princeton, and New York.

  
  
  

**We'll trust you to:**

* Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing APAC team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and technical excellence.
* Build strategic partnerships with regional Data, Operations, Product, Engineering, and Vendor Management leaders to identify priorities, align on outcomes, and drive data-driven decision making.
* Drive operational excellence through workflow measurement, process optimization, productivity benchmarking, and scalable automation initiatives, including AI-enabled solutions.
* Oversee data quality governance and decision analytics capabilities, leveraging statistical methods, experimentation, and AI evaluation frameworks to improve quality, quantify impact, and reduce operational risk.
* Partner with global QMI and Technical Project Management teams to deliver governed analytics platforms, reusable frameworks, and disciplined project execution, ensuring measurable business impact and consistent technical standards.

  
  

**You'll Need to Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
* 5+ years of people leadership experience, with a proven track record of building, coaching, and developing high-performing analytical or technical teams.
* Strong analytical background in areas such as Applied Statistics, Decision Science, Data Quality, Operations Research, or a related discipline, with experience designing measurement frameworks and evaluating operational systems.
* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, with experience using tools such as Python, SQL, or equivalent analytics platform
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex cross-functional environments, and drive alignment across regional and global teams.
* Experience in operational performance and quality management, leveraging data-driven approaches to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making.
* Experience leveraging AI, causal inference, Bayesian modelling, and LLM evaluation to drive operational and decision-making improvements.
* Ability to scale impact through others by setting direction, coaching teams, and establishing repeatable frameworks and operating mechanisms.
* A strategic yet execution-oriented mindset, capable of balancing long-term capability building with immediate business impact.
* Demonstrated continuous career growth within an organization
* Fluency in written and spoken English

  
  

**We’d love to see:**

* Familiarity with enterprise data quality and governance frameworks such as DCAM, DAMA, statistical quality monitoring, and semantic validation.
* Experience with modern data platforms and analytics architectures, including Spark, dbt, Iceberg/Delta, Lakehouses, or Knowledge Graphs.
* Knowledge of workflow management and operational tooling, such as Jira, queue management, or work routing platforms.
* Experience in financial market data, global operations, or third-party vendor management environments.

  

**If this sounds like you:**

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are, but in the meantime feel free to have a look at this: https://www.bloomberg.com/professional

  
  

**Learn more about our offices and benefits:**

India | https://www.bloomberg.com/India

  
  

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our podcast series for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

  

**Accommodations**
------------------

Bloomberg provides reasonable adjustment/accommodation to individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable adjustment/accommodation include but are not limited to making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format or using specialized equipment. title: Systems Reliability Engineer II
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

**The Opportunity**

Are you a top-tier Systems Reliability Engineer with a strong expertise in networking, virtualization, and cloud technologies, along with a passion for delivering exceptional customer support? If so, you'll thrive in our dynamic hybrid team at Nutanix, where you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects, collaborate with leading technology specialists, and make a meaningful impact on customer satisfaction in a supportive environment that prioritizes growth and work-life balance.

**About the Team**

The Systems Reliability Engineer III will join a dynamic and collaborative team focused on delivering exceptional customer support and ensuring the reliability of services at Nutanix. Based in Pune, this team is composed of top-tier technology specialists who thrive on innovation and problem-solving. Emphasizing a culture of continuous learning, knowledge-sharing, and teamwork, the team is dedicated to improving customer satisfaction and contributing to overall business success by working on cutting-edge projects that directly impact customers’ experiences and successes.

You will report to the Sr. Manager, Worldwide Support, who fosters a supportive and customer-centric leadership style. This manager emphasizes collaboration and growth, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to excel in their role. The work setup for this position is hybrid, requiring team members to be in the office three days a week for meetings and collaboration, while allowing flexibility for remote work on other days.

* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring high customer satisfaction.

* Proficient in communication, both written and verbal, for effective cross-team collaboration.

* Degree in Engineering or Computer Science preferred.
* Customer-driven mindset focused on delivering high-quality support experiences.
* Familiarity with technologies from partners such as VMware, Citrix, and Microsoft.
* Ability to develop tools and enhance internal and external knowledge bases.

title: Cloud Infrastructure & Agentic Architect (f/m/d)
description:
* Pune (IND)
* IT

* Fulltime
* Published: 2026-10-13

**What do we do?**
------------------

**Introducing Thinkproject Platform**
  
  
Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies.

By combining information management expertise and in-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem.

**What your day will look like**
--------------------------------

**About the Role**
  
We are looking for a **Cloud Infrastructure & Agentic Architect (f/m/d)** to own the technical foundation of our cloud platform. You will maintain our service catalog, design architectural blueprints, establish the observability standard, and — most distinctively — bring hands-on LLM-driven tooling skills to a team actively shaping what the next generation of cloud operations looks like.

This is a senior individual-contributor role reporting to the **Cloud Architect Manager (who reports to the CIO)**, with direct CIO-adjacent visibility. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering and technology strategy, contributing to platform roadmap decisions — not just executing them. The team is small, ownership is total, and iteration cycles are short. You will be expected to resolve ambiguity, align expectations, and establish technical clarity across a diverse group of stakeholders.

**Time allocation (approximate):**
  
~40% LLM-driven tooling & workflow design | ~30% architecture & catalog governance | ~20%
  
observability | ~10% collaboration & documentation

**Key Responsibilities**
  
**Service Catalog & Platform Governance**

* Build and maintain a minimalistic, opinionated service catalog of approved cloud components across Google Cloud and Azure
* Apply a serverless-first, PaaS-first philosophy — challenge complexity and push back on
    
  unnecessary infrastructure sprawl
* For every approved catalog entry, deliver production-ready configuration: IaC, security baseline,observability hooks, and runbook
* Scrutinise every new component request and justify its addition in terms of cost, operational overhead, and platform alignment

**Cloud Architecture**

* Define, document, and govern cloud architectural blueprints across networking, compute, storage and data layers
* Design event-driven pipelines that trigger AI-assisted validation, drift detection, and deployment gates
* Serve as the technical authority on platform design decisions within your domain

**LLM-Driven Operations**

* Implement LLM-based automated deployment capabilities using tools such as OpenCode, Claude Code, or equivalent frameworks
* Design and operate infrastructure workflows augmented by AI agents — from deployment validation to configuration drift detection
* Stay ahead of the market in AI-assisted tooling and bring relevant innovations into the platform

**Observability**

* Define the observability standard: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, dashboards, and SLO/SLA frameworks
* Establish platform-level KPIs and ensure consistent adoption across engineering teams

**Collaboration**

* Partner with DevOps and Engineering teams to embed platform standards into delivery pipelines
* Partner with SecOps to integrate all controls and security requirements
* Document everything: blueprints, ADRs, runbooks, onboarding guides

**What you need to fulfill the role**
-------------------------------------

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
  
You have operated multi-cloud Kubernetes environments in production, built IaC pipelines with Terraform and have hands-on experience with LLM-driven tooling in real engineering workflows. Specifically:

* Proven cloud networking experience: firewalls, gateways, VPCs, VPNs, private service connect, and network security groups
* Strong, current proficiency across **Google Cloud Platform** (GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, VPC, Cloud Armor, Pub/Sub, Artifact Registry) and **Microsoft Azure**
* Proven IaC experience with **Terraform** (required); Ansible a strong plus
* **Proven hands-on LLM tooling experience**: must have used **OpenCode, Claude Code,** or equivalent AI-assisted coding/deployment agents in real engineering workflows
* **Kubernetes at scale:** demonstrated experience operating **AKS** (Azure Kubernetes Service) and **GKE** (Google Kubernetes Engine) — cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, and workload management
* Experience with **Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or similar cloud** model gardens
* Ability to proactively coordinate with stakeholders to remove ambiguity and build clarity in migration designs
* Experience in Agile/fast-iteration environments with high individual ownership

**Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)**

* Knowledge of C5, SecNumCloud, ISO 27001, or equivalent cloud security frameworks
* FinOps — cost attribution, rightsizing, commitment strategies
* Prior experience in a SaaS product company at scale
* Platform engineering / SRE background

**Soft Skills**

* Intense technical curiosity — you follow the market, test new tools, and form opinions before they become mainstream
* Strong problem-solving discipline: you reach for first principles, not familiarity
* Ownership mindset — you build it, you run it, you improve it
* Clear written and verbal communication: able to document decisions and explain them to non specialists
* Operates well under pressure and tight constraints — energised by hard problems
* Strong negotiation skills — fact-driven and data-driven: you argue with evidence, not opinion
* Highly collaborative: you build alignment across engineering, SecOps, and leadership

**What success looks like**

We target a mature and highly automated cloud foundation designed for modern enterprise SaaS. The long-term success of this role is defined by:

* **Robust Service Catalog & Governance:** An established service catalog baseline featuring approved, standardized cloud components with built-in compliance, IaC automation, and production-ready monitoring.
* **Enterprise-Wide Observability Adoption:** Broad deployment of unified platform-level observability standards across engineering teams, incorporating logging, distributed tracing, and clear SLA frameworks.
* **AI-Accelerated Workflows:** Active, production-ready LLM-driven deployment, validation, and configuration drift-detection pipelines to streamline system management.
* **Sustainable Architecture Blueprints:** Completed architectural blueprints and ADR documents defining the multi-cloud framework, paired with scalable FinOps cost tracking principles.

**You're probably NOT a fit if**

* You need a large team to delegate to before making decisions
* You prefer deep specialisation in a single cloud over breadth across two
* You're not actively following the LLM/AI tooling space
* You're looking for a role with clearly defined scope and minimal ambiguity

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Multicultural team across 7 countries (Germany, France, UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, Australia)
* Hybrid-first working
* Continuous learning & certification budget
* Open, inclusive, and high-ownership culture
* Learning programmes | Career growth | Leadership access

At Thinkproject, we run feedback cycles that are honest and frequent. We believe the best engineering cultures are built on trust, transparency, and shared ownership — not hierarchy. Our Pune team is a core part of a global organisation, collaborating across time zones with colleagues in Germany, France, the UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia.

**Lunch 'n' Learn Sessions I Women's Network I LGBTQIA+ Network I Coffee Chat Roulette I Free English Lessons I Thinkproject Academy I Social Events I Volunteering Activities I Open Forum with Leadership Team (Tp Café) I Hybrid working I Unlimited learning**
  
  
We are a passionate bunch here. To join Thinkproject is to shape what our company becomes. We take feedback from our staff very seriously and give them the tools they need to help us create our fantastic culture of mutual respect. We believe that investing in our staff is crucial to the success of our business.

**Your contact:**
-----------------

Mehal Mehta

**How to apply**
  
Submit your application at careers.thinkproject.com, including:

* Salary expectations
* Potential start date
* **A short write-up (max 300 words) on the most complex cloud infrastructure or LLM-driven** **workflow challenge you have solved — this is the most important part of your application**

Working at thinkproject.com - **think career. think ahead.**

description:
Job description

Company and benefits

Role

Customer Success Eng II

Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Customer Success Engineer will serve as a senior technical advisor, product enablement leader, and customer intelligence partner for the India Customer Success organization. This role partners closely with CSMs to improve customer outcomes through technical guidance, product adoption strategies, scalable education, and data-driven risk identification.
  
  
A core focus of this role is helping CSMs confidently speak to the value of UKG products and newly released features. The Lead CSE will create practical enablement assets, demo experiences, talk tracks, and field-ready guidance that allow CSMs to connect capabilities to customer business outcomes in both 1:1 and 1:many settings.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Partner with CSMs to understand customer business objectives, technical challenges, adoption gaps, and opportunities to leverage UKG capabilities more effectively.
* Provide architecture and technical guidance across configuration, integrations, data models, APIs, security, governance, and product best practices.
* Lead technical discovery, solution reviews, adoption workshops, and customer-facing product discussions when Success Engineering support is required.
* Analyze customer health, Compass signals, adoption data, support trends, renewal information, and product usage indicators to identify accounts needing CSE attention.
* Translate data insights into clear recommendations for CSMs, including suggested outreach, product adoption plays, enablement opportunities, and risk mitigation actions.
* Mentor Senior Customer Success Engineers and help establish standards for technical assessments, product enablement, risk analysis, and reusable content.

Product Enablement & Content Creation Responsibilities
  

* Own the design and production of scalable product enablement for the CS organization, including short-form demo videos, feature walkthroughs, webinar decks, technical explainers, customer-ready talk tracks, and CSM coaching guides.
* Build demo libraries organized by product area, customer outcome, persona, and use case so CSMs can quickly show how UKG functionality supports business value.
* Translate new product releases into CS-ready enablement packages that explain what changed, why it matters, which customers benefit, how to position the value, and what CSMs should listen for in customer conversations.
* Host recurring enablement webinars, office hours, and product deep-dive sessions that help CSMs understand releases, adoption opportunities, common objections, and value-based messaging.
* Create CSM-facing value narratives that connect product capabilities to outcomes such as adoption, efficiency, compliance, employee experience, retention, payroll accuracy, workforce optimization, and operational scale.
* Package repeatable product adoption plays and success accelerators that CSMs can use in Success Plans, renewal preparation, risk mitigation, and customer business reviews.
* Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Support, Services, and Enablement to ensure CS teams receive timely, accurate, and practical product readiness content.

  
Qualifications
  

* 7+ years of experience implementing, consulting on, supporting, or advising customers on UKG products.
* Deep expertise in one or more UKG solution areas such as Pro, WFM, Ready, Talent, Payroll, Reporting, Integrations, or Security.
* Strong ability to connect product capability, technical design, customer goals, and measurable business outcomes.
* Experience creating demos, webinars, enablement materials, product guides, or technical content for customer-facing teams.
* Excellent facilitation and presentation skills with the ability to engage CSMs, customer executives, technical stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.
* Strong analytical skills and experience interpreting customer health, adoption, support, telemetry, or renewal signals.
* Experience with Gainsight, Compass, Power BI, Salesforce, SQL, telemetry, or customer intelligence tools preferred.

  
Success Measures
  

* CSMs can clearly articulate the value of UKG products and new features using consistent talk tracks and practical examples.
* Enablement assets are reusable, field-ready, and adopted by India CS and broader Customer Success teams.
* CSE recommendations help CSMs prioritize the right accounts, risks, and adoption opportunities.
* Product release readiness improves across CS through timely, relevant, outcome-oriented enablement.

title: Value Realization Manager
description:
**Who are we?**


Checkmarx is the leader in application security and ensures that enterprises worldwide can secure their application development from code to cloud. Our consolidated platform and services address the needs of enterprises by improving security and reducing TCO, while simultaneously building trust between AppSec, developers, and CISOs. At Checkmarx, we believe it’s not just about *finding risk but* *remediating* it across the entire application footprint and software supply chain with one seamless process for all relevant stakeholders.


We are honored to serve more than 1,800 customers, which includes 40 percent of all Fortune 100 companies, including Siemens, Airbus, Salesforce, Stellantis, Adidas, Wal\-Mart, and Sanofi.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a \*\*Value Realization Manager\*\* to join our Revenue Operations team. This is a newly created role focused on one clear mission: making sure the GTM technology we've invested in—Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar GTM platforms—actually delivers the business outcomes it was purchased for.


You'll sit at the intersection of RevOps, Sales Enablement, and Vendor Management. Rather than just administering tools, you'll own the \*value\* they generate: adoption, ROI, workflow efficiency, and measurable impact on pipeline and revenue. If you've spent time as a customer success manager on the vendor side of GTM tech and are ready to apply that customer success discipline internally, this role is built for you.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own the end\-to\-end value realization strategy for our core GTM tech stack (Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and call recorder tools such as Kaia or Clari Copilot)
* Define and track adoption metrics, usage benchmarks, and ROI models for each platform; report regularly to RevOps and Sales leadership

**Strongly Preferred:**
